content.short: Meteora is Solana's premier yield layer and DEX featuring an advanced Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker (DLMM) for maximum capital efficiency.
content.description: Meteora is a leading decentralized liquidity protocol and yield layer built natively on the Solana blockchain, designed to maximize capital efficiency for the entire ecosystem. Rebranded from Mercurial Finance, the platform is renowned for its innovative Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker (DLMM) technology. This model allows liquidity providers to concentrate their capital within specific price bins, significantly increasing fee capture and reducing slippage for traders compared to traditional AMMs. In addition to its core trading features, Meteora serves as a vital yield aggregator, providing automated vaults that optimize returns for major assets on Solana.
content.meta: Meteora provides advanced DLMM liquidity pools and high-efficiency yield layers for the Solana blockchain. Discover Meteora on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
